1 """W3 of the active set — the steward steps in (PLAN v1.3.2 fits 8–9, 2026-10-01).
2 
3 ONE nudge at a speaking boundary, derived from the records alone — never a model turn, never a write — in his words,
4 with its receipt (the fact it read) and one-click acts. The kinds, in the order one wins:
5 
6   dated      a dated part due within three days in a goal he is NOT working in now ("Excuse me: … is due tomorrow")
7   deck_wait  an initiative that waits on him and is only on deck ("… waits on you and is only on deck — make it active?")
8   starving   a Tier-1 goal untouched for a week, a Tier-2 for two ("… untouched for 12 days — put one of its cockpits on deck?")
9   seed       a seed that reads like a goal ("the seed '…' reads like a goal — make it one?")
10   free       nothing active and something on deck ("A free moment: … is on deck — make it active?")
11 
12 "Not now" is a receipt kept in the Campaign's own folder (``.ecgberht/nudges.json``) that silences THAT nudge until its
13 fact changes: the key names the kind, the subject and the fact, so a new date, a new wait, another week of silence or
14 another seed is a new nudge. Never twice for the same fact; never more than one at a boundary; nothing moves without
15 his click or his word (the acts are the Campaign's own: seat, promote, not_now).
16 """

27 STARVE_DAYS = {1: 7, 2: 14}
28 NOT_DATED = frozenset({"deck_wait", "starving", "seed", "free"})     # every kind but the interrupt lane's (2026-10-03)

37 def _iso(d):
38     if isinstance(d, date):
39         return d
40     try:
41         return datetime.strptime(str(d)[:10], "%Y-%m-%d").date()
42     except Exception:
43         return None
44

46 def when_words(d, today):
47     """'today' · 'tomorrow' · 'Fri, Oct 3' — the date as he says it."""
48     if d == today:
49         return "today"
50     if d == today + timedelta(days=1):
51         return "tomorrow"
52     return d.strftime("%a, %b %d").replace(" 0", " ")

55 def _open(p):
56     return isinstance(p, dict) and not p.get("done") and not p.get("closed") and str(p.get("status") or "").lower() not in ("done", "parked", "cancelled", "dropped")

59 def fact_key(kind, subject, fact):
60     """The receipt's key: the kind, the subject and the fact it read — a changed fact is a new nudge."""
61     h = hashlib.sha1(("%s|%s|%s" % (kind, subject, fact)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]
62     return "%s:%s:%s" % (kind, str(subject)[:40], h)

65 def _goals_at_hand(initiatives, working):
66     """The goals he is working in now: those with an ACTIVE initiative, or a cockpit with a live session."""
67     at_hand = set()
68     for i in initiatives or ():
69         for p in i.get("parts") or ():
70             if p.get("seat") == "active" or (p.get("pid") and p["pid"] in (working or set())):
71                 at_hand.add(i["id"])
72     return at_hand

75 def derive(initiatives, facts=None, seeds=None, working=None, today=None, strip_ages=None, goal_last_at=None,
76            dismissed=None, scope_goal=None, campaign_pid="", head_lead=None, kinds=None):
77     """The one nudge for this boundary, or None. ``scope_goal`` narrows it to one goal's conversation (the Campaign
78     page's place): only that goal's dated parts, deck waits and starvation; seeds and the free moment belong to the
79     High Seat's brief. ``dismissed`` is the receipts file read (``read_dismissed``). ``head_lead`` is (pid, part name)
80     of the brief's own lead sentence: a part the head already names is never nudged too (Grok W3, RC-3). ``kinds``
81     limits the candidates to those kinds (None = all): one lane per item (John, 2026-10-03) - the Cave's interrupt lane
82     asks for ``{"dated"}``, its panel and the Star Chart's goal places for the rest, so a dated item shows once."""
83     today = today or date.today()
84     inits = [i for i in initiatives or () if isinstance(i, dict) and i.get("status") not in ("done", "parked")]
85     if scope_goal:
86         inits = [i for i in inits if i.get("id") == scope_goal]
87     dismissed = dismissed or {}
88     working = working or set()
89     seeds = [s for s in (seeds if isinstance(seeds, (list, tuple)) else ()) if isinstance(s, dict)]   # rows, never a count
90     at_hand = _goals_at_hand(initiatives, working)
91     lead_pid, lead_part = (str(head_lead[0] or ""), str(head_lead[1] or "")) if isinstance(head_lead, (list, tuple)) and len(head_lead) == 2 else ("", "")
92 
93     def _is_lead(p):
94         name = str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "")
95         return bool((lead_pid and p.get("pid") == lead_pid) or (lead_part and name == lead_part))
96     cands = []
97 
98     def add(kind, subject, fact, text, why, acts, goal=None, rank=0):
99         key = fact_key(kind, subject, fact)
100         if (kinds is not None and kind not in kinds) or key in dismissed:
101             return
102         cands.append({"kind": kind, "key": key, "fact": str(fact), "text": text, "why": why, "acts": acts, "goal": goal, "rank": rank})
103 
104     # 1. a dated thing near while he is elsewhere
105     best = None
106     for i in inits:
107         for p in i.get("parts") or ():
108             if not _open(p) or p.get("broken"):
109                 continue
110             d = _iso(p.get("date"))
111             if d is None or d < today or (d - today).days > DATED_WINDOW_DAYS:
112                 continue
113             if not scope_goal and i["id"] in at_hand:
114                 continue      # his own goal at hand: the head says it, not a nudge
115             if best is None or d < best[0]:
116                 best = (d, i, p)
117     if best:
118         d, i, p = best
119         name = str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "a part")
120         # in the goal's own place the goal is already open on screen: no link to it (Grok W3)
121         opens = [{"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s?open=%s" % (campaign_pid, i["id"]), "label": "open the goal"}] if campaign_pid and not scope_goal else []
122         if p.get("pid"):
123             opens.insert(0, {"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s" % p["pid"], "label": "open the cockpit"})
124         add("dated", p.get("id") or name, d.isoformat(),
125             "Excuse me: %s is due %s (%s)." % (name, when_words(d, today), i.get("name") or "a goal"),
126             "the part's date on the Campaign record: %s" % d.isoformat(), opens, goal=i["id"], rank=1)
127 
128     # 2. an initiative that needs him and is only on deck - unless the head's own sentence already leads with it
129     for i in inits:
130         for p in i.get("parts") or ():
131             if _open(p) and p.get("seat") == "deck" and p.get("needs_you") and not _is_lead(p):
132                 wait = re.sub(r"^waiting on you[:\s]*", "", str(p.get("state") or ""), flags=re.I).strip(" .") or "a wait"
133                 name = str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "it")
134                 add("deck_wait", p.get("id"), wait,
135                     "%s waits on you and is only on deck — make it active?" % name,
136                     "its record: needs you · %s" % wait[:120],
137                     [{"act": "seat", "step": p.get("id"), "seat": "active", "label": "make it active"}] + ([{"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s" % p["pid"], "label": "open"}] if p.get("pid") else []),
138                     goal=i["id"], rank=2)
139                 break
140 
141     # 3. a top goal starving
142     for i in inits:
143         tier = i.get("tier")
144         if tier not in STARVE_DAYS or i["id"] in at_hand:
145             continue
146         ages = [int((strip_ages or {}).get(p.get("pid"), 0) or 0) for p in i.get("parts") or () if p.get("pid")]
147         age = max(ages) if ages else 0
148         last = (goal_last_at or {}).get(i["id"])
149         if not age and last:
150             try:
151                 age = (today - _iso(last)).days if _iso(last) else 0
152             except Exception:
153                 age = 0
154         if age >= STARVE_DAYS[tier]:
155             # the cockpit offered is the one whose age was quoted when it is unseated, else the first unseated (Grok W3)
156             unseated = [p for p in i.get("parts") or () if _open(p) and p.get("kind") in ("project", "effort") and not p.get("seat")]
157             unseated.sort(key=lambda p: -int((strip_ages or {}).get(p.get("pid"), 0) or 0))
158             cockpit = unseated[0] if unseated else None
159             acts = ([{"act": "seat", "step": cockpit.get("id"), "seat": "deck", "label": "put %s on deck" % str(cockpit.get("target") or cockpit.get("text") or "it")[:40]}] if cockpit else [])
160             if campaign_pid:
161                 acts.append({"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s?open=%s" % (campaign_pid, i["id"]), "label": "open the goal"})
162             add("starving", i["id"], age // 7,
163                 "%s is a Tier-%d goal untouched for %d days — %s" % (i.get("name") or "a goal", tier, age, "put one of its cockpits on deck?" if cockpit else "pick it up?"),
164                 "the strip's anti_starvation_age_days of its cockpits, else the days since its last turn: %d" % age, acts, goal=i["id"], rank=3)
165 
166     if not scope_goal:
167         # 4. a seed that reads like a goal
168         for s in seeds or ():
169             text = " ".join(str(s.get("text") or "").split())
170             words = text.split()
171             if len(words) >= 6 and not text.endswith("?") and (_SEED_VERBS.search(text) or re.search(r"\bby\b", text, re.I)):
172                 add("seed", s.get("id"), s.get("id"),
173                     "the seed ‘%s’ reads like a goal — make it one?" % (text[:90] + ("…" if len(text) > 90 else "")),
174                     "a seed on the Campaign's strip, %d words with a verb" % len(words),
175                     [{"act": "promote", "seed": s.get("id"), "tier": 2, "area": "", "done_when": text[:200], "label": "make it a goal (tier 2)"}] + ([{"act": "open", "href": "/project/%s" % campaign_pid, "label": "open the seeds"}] if campaign_pid else []),
176                     rank=4)
177                 break
178         # 5. a free moment: nothing active, something on deck - never the part whose deck wait he already put off
179         # (that would be the same "make it active?" twice)
180         put_off = {k.split(":", 2)[1] for k in dismissed if k.startswith("deck_wait:")}
181         active = [p for i in inits for p in i.get("parts") or () if _open(p) and p.get("seat") == "active"]
182         deck = sorted([(i, p) for i in inits for p in i.get("parts") or () if _open(p) and p.get("seat") == "deck" and str(p.get("id"))[:40] not in put_off and not _is_lead(p)],
183                       key=lambda t: (t[1].get("seat_order") if isinstance(t[1].get("seat_order"), int) else 999))
184         if not active and deck:
185             i, p = deck[0]
186             name = str(p.get("target") or p.get("text") or "it")
187             add("free", p.get("id"), p.get("id"),
188                 "A free moment: %s is on deck (%s) — make it active?" % (name, i.get("name") or "a goal"),
189                 "nothing is active; the top of On deck", [{"act": "seat", "step": p.get("id"), "seat": "active", "label": "make it active"}], goal=i["id"], rank=5)
190 
191     if not cands:
192         return None
193     cands.sort(key=lambda c: c["rank"])
194     return cands[0]

197 def _path(campaign_dir):
198     return Path(campaign_dir) / NUDGES_FILE
199

201 def read_dismissed(campaign_dir):
202     """The 'not now' receipts: {key: {at, fact, text}}; empty when none."""
203     try:
204         d = json.loads(_path(campaign_dir).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
205         return d if isinstance(d, dict) else {}
206     except Exception:
207         return {}
208 
209 
210 def dismiss(campaign_dir, key, fact="", text=""):
211     """His 'not now': a receipt that silences that nudge until its fact changes. Written whole, never raises."""
212     key = str(key or "").strip()
213     if not key or len(key) > 120 or "/" in key or "\\" in key:
214         return {"ok": False, "error": "no such nudge"}
215     d = read_dismissed(campaign_dir)
216     d[key] = {"at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "fact": str(fact or "")[:200], "text": str(text or "")[:240]}
217     try:
218         p = _path(campaign_dir); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
219         tmp = p.with_suffix(".json.tmp"); tmp.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"); os.replace(str(tmp), str(p))
220     except OSError as e:
221         return {"ok": False, "error": "the receipt could not be kept: %s" % e}
222     return {"ok": True, "key": key}
223 
224 
225 def undismiss(campaign_dir, key):
226     d = read_dismissed(campaign_dir)
227     if str(key) not in d:
228         return {"ok": False, "error": "that nudge was not silenced"}
229     d.pop(str(key), None)
230     try:
231         p = _path(campaign_dir); tmp = p.with_suffix(".json.tmp"); tmp.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"); os.replace(str(tmp), str(p))
232     except OSError as e:
233         return {"ok": False, "error": "the receipt could not be dropped: %s" % e}
234     return {"ok": True, "key": str(key)}

237 # ── the interrupt lane's ready-to-resume note (John, 2026-10-03: the lane lives on the Cave of Wonders) ─────────────
238 # When he opens a dated item from the lane, what he was on is kept as one line; the Cave shows it at the top of the
239 # panel ("You were on: ...") until he clears it or two days pass. One note at a time; never raises.
240 
241 def write_resume(campaign_dir, note, switched_to=""):
242     note = " ".join(str(note or "").split())[:240]
243     if not note:
244         return {"ok": False, "error": "nothing to keep"}
245     d = {"at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "note": note, "switched_to": " ".join(str(switched_to or "").split())[:160]}
246     try:
247         p = Path(campaign_dir) / RESUME_FILE; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
248         tmp = p.with_suffix(".json.tmp"); tmp.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"); os.replace(str(tmp), str(p))
249     except OSError as e:
250         return {"ok": False, "error": "the note could not be kept: %s" % e}
251     return {"ok": True, **d}
252 
253 
254 def read_resume(campaign_dir, today=None):
255     """The note, or None when there is none or it is older than RESUME_DAYS."""
256     try:
257         d = json.loads((Path(campaign_dir) / RESUME_FILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
258     except Exception:
259         return None
260     if not isinstance(d, dict) or not d.get("note"):
261         return None
262     at = _iso(str(d.get("at") or "")[:10])
263     if at and ((today or date.today()) - at).days > RESUME_DAYS:
264         return None
265     return d
266 
267 
268 def clear_resume(campaign_dir):
269     was = read_resume(campaign_dir)
270     try:
271         (Path(campaign_dir) / RESUME_FILE).unlink()
272     except FileNotFoundError:
273         pass
274     except OSError as e:
275         return {"ok": False, "error": "the note could not be cleared: %s" % e}
276     return {"ok": True, "was": was}

283 def _pm_read(campaign_dir):

286         return d if isinstance(d, dict) else {}
287     except Exception:

291 def _pm_write(campaign_dir, d):
292     try:
293         p = Path(campaign_dir) / PREMORTEM_FILE; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
294         tmp = p.with_suffix(".json.tmp"); tmp.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"); os.replace(str(tmp), str(p))
295         return True
296     except OSError:
297         return False

304 def ask_premortem(campaign_dir, goal_id, reason):
305     goal_id = str(goal_id or "").strip()
306     if not goal_id or "/" in goal_id or "\\" in goal_id:
307         return False
308     d = _pm_read(campaign_dir)
309     d[goal_id] = {"at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), "reason": " ".join(str(reason or "").split())[:160]}
310     return _pm_write(campaign_dir, d)

313 def close_premortem(campaign_dir, goal_id):
314     d = _pm_read(campaign_dir)
315     was = d.pop(str(goal_id), None)
316     return was if _pm_write(campaign_dir, d) else None
